tips.text: The Ministry of Tourism's Jordan Pass site sells three passes, from 70 to 80 JD, with one to three days at Petra and free entry to over 40 attractions; the tourist visa fee is waived if you buy the pass before arrival and stay at least two nights (3 days). The UK Foreign Office gives the minimum as 3 nights and advises buying the pass only from the official website.

faq.question: Do US citizens need a visa for Jordan?
faq.answer: Yes, but it is issued on arrival: a single-entry visa costs JOD 40 and is valid for one month. The UK Foreign Office says a visit visa can be extended online for up to 6 months. The Ministry of Tourism's Jordan Pass site says the visa fee is waived if you buy the pass before arrival and stay at least two nights (3 days).

faq.question: Is the Jordan Pass worth it?
faq.answer: The Ministry of Tourism's Jordan Pass site sells three passes — 70 JD (one day at Petra), 75 JD (two consecutive days) and 80 JD (three consecutive days) — each with free entry to over 40 attractions, and the tourist visa fee is waived if you buy it before arrival and stay at least two nights (3 days).

faq.question: How do I pay for the Jordan visa on arrival?
faq.answer: No official source we could read states how the visa-on-arrival fee is paid. The Ministry of Tourism's Jordan Pass site says pass holders present the pass at the airport visa office to have the fee waived, and should show it printed out because the QR code may not scan from a phone.

faq.question: Can I stay in Jordan longer than 30 days?
faq.answer: Yes. The Jordan Tourism Board says the visa can be extended at any police station, and the UK Foreign Office says a visit visa can be extended online for up to 6 months and that you could be fined if you overstay.

faq.question: Can Indian citizens get a visa on arrival in Jordan?
faq.answer: Yes. India is not on the Ministry of Interior's list of restricted nationalities — the ones that need prior approval — and the Jordan Tourism Board says unrestricted nationalities can get a visa at Queen Alia International Airport or any other border crossing except King Hussein Bridge and the ferry from Egypt.
